question: What will be the percentage change in front-month WTI crude oil futures (CL=F on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-18 to the close on 2026-09-02?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-02 / close on 2026-08-18 - 1), using daily closes of CL=F on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-02, the last close before it is used.
research:
I've finished the searches and am writing up the findings now. Note that I couldn't load Yahoo, Barchart or Wikipedia pages directly because the proxy blocked them, so everything below comes from search snippets. I left out every item dated after 2026-08-19.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-18: Yahoo Finance's CL=F history page, as indexed by search, shows open 84.98, high 85.94, low 84.57, **close 84.94**. The prior close was 84.50 on 2026-08-17. I could not open the page myself to confirm it. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CL%3DF/history)
- That figure fits CNBC's report that US crude settled at $84.50 on Aug 17. A Vietnamese report put WTI at about $83.90 to $84.10 during Aug 18, so the intraday quotes there were a bit lower. [baolaocai](https://baolaocai.vn/gia-xang-dau-hom-nay-1882026-brent-vuot-91-usd-ap-luc-tang-trong-nuoc-post906340.html)
- **The contract roll matters.** By standard NYMEX rules, the September contract (CLU26) should expire around Thursday 2026-08-20. That is my own calculation; no source confirms it. CL=F on 2026-09-02 will almost certainly be the October contract (CLV26). The curve is in backwardation (near-month contracts priced above later ones), so the roll alone would push the measured change down by roughly the Sep/Oct spread. I could not find that spread. For a rough guide, on 2026-08-06 Brent October traded $1.50 above November, about 1.6%. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/premium-oil-news-wti-and-brent-face-volatility-if-hormuz-deal-fails-to-restore-flows-1615163) One search summary called the Aug 18 Yahoo row "October", which I could not verify. If Yahoo had already rolled, there is no roll effect left.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. On 2026-08-19, early trading had WTI around $85.31, about 0.4% above the Aug 18 close. [Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/commodities/crude-oil-prices-rise-as-hormuz-shipping-uncertainty-keeps-traders-cautious-august-19-2026)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-19: Bloomberg's wrap says Brent rose about 2% to just under $94. It attributes the rise to Trump's threat to crush Iran's economy, which hurt the chances of ending the war. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-19/latest-oil-market-news-and-analysis-for-aug-19) A Barchart item cited a 4-week high, the Strait of Hormuz staying closed, and a weaker dollar.
- 2026-08-19: Both benchmarks closed Aug 18 at their highest since July 24. On Aug 18 Trump said the Strait was open; Iranian officials said it was still closed. [Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/commodities/crude-oil-prices-rise-as-hormuz-shipping-uncertainty-keeps-traders-cautious-august-19-2026)
- 2026-08-17: WTI rose 2.6% to $84.50 and Brent to $90.87. Iran ruled out extending the June memorandum on reopening Hormuz and threatened to go on the offensive. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/oil-prices-iran-war-strait-hormuz.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html)
- 2026-08-12: Prices rose after attacks hurt hopes that Hormuz would reopen. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/12/oil-prices-rise-as-attacks-dent-hopes-for-strait-of-hormuz-reopening)
- 2026-08-11: WTI went above $83 after Iran said the Strait would not open until its conditions were met. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/11/oil-prices-today-us-crude-84.html)
- 2026-08-10: WTI rose about 5% to $82.13. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/10/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-iran.html)
- 2026-08-06: Prices jumped after Iran published a restrictive draft plan for Hormuz. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/06/oil-price-iran-war-strait-hormuz-oman-deal.html)
- 2026-08-03: WTI fell about 5% to $80.34 on hopes of a deal and after Trump called off a strike. Prices dropped more than 7% that week. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/08/03/oil-prices-slump-on-potential-us-iran-deal-to-open-strait-of-hormuz/)
- August 2026: OPEC and the IEA cut their 2026 demand outlooks. [OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Fall-as-OPEC-and-IEA-Slash-2026-Demand-Outlooks.html)

## 4. Base rates
- The war started 2026-02-28. Since then, single-day WTI moves of 2% to 5% have been common, and moves of 5% or more have occurred several times in August alone (Aug 3, Aug 10). [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/10/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-trump-iran.html)
- Recent swings: Brent fell almost $20 from its 2026-07-23 high to 2026-08-06. WTI then went from $80.34 on Aug 3 to $84.94 on Aug 18, up about 6% in two weeks. [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/premium-oil-news-wti-and-brent-face-volatility-if-hormuz-deal-fails-to-restore-flows-1615163)
- My rough estimate for this window (10 trading days): in normal regimes the standard deviation of front-month WTI moves is about 5% to 6%. In the current headline-driven regime it looks more like 8% to 12%. News about a deal or escalation tends to cause jumps in either direction.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market covering WTI on 2026-09-02. Kalshi does list daily and hourly WTI markets. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxwtih/wti-hourly/kxwtih-26aug1402)
- The EIA's August STEO projected Brent at about $85 for Q3 2026, falling to about $69 in 2027. It expects reduced Hormuz flows to keep drawing down inventories and to hold prices near early-August levels. [EIA STEO](https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/)
- I did not find a recent forecast from Goldman Sachs or any other bank.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-08-20: expected expiry of CLU26 and Yahoo's switch to CLV26, which brings the roll effect described in section 1.
- 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-26: EIA weekly petroleum status reports. Labor Day (2026-09-07) falls after resolution.
- US-Iran diplomacy, the status of the Hormuz memorandum, and Trump's threats against Iran's economy. These are the main drivers in both directions.
- I found no OPEC+ meeting scheduled before 2026-09-02. The last decision I found was from 2026-06-07 (+188 kb/d for July). [Annahar](https://en.annahar.com/en/317595/seven-opec-countries-increase-oil-production-by-188000-barrels-per-day-in-july)
- Moves in the dollar index; on Aug 19 the dollar was down sharply.
